# AIReady Executive

> Executive & boardroom AI readiness advisory. A fixed-fee, fixed-timeline engagement that takes C-suite leaders and boards from AI gap to boardroom-ready in 30 days — executive alignment above the Chief AI Officer layer, delivered directly by a senior practitioner. Not a course, not a cohort, not a Big-Four analyst team.

## The framework (six pillars)
- Executive AI Readiness Assessment — an honest audit of leadership, culture, data, and governance before any investment.
- Outcomes-First Strategy Design — define business outcomes before evaluating tools or vendors.
- AI-Ready Culture & Change Architecture — the signals, norms, and operating model the organization will follow.
- Tool & Vendor Evaluation Framework — a structured lens for assessing AI tools against real use cases.
- Board-Level Readiness Narrative — a defensible AI strategy to present to board, investors, and leadership.
- 90-Day Execution Blueprint — a sequenced roadmap with owners, milestones, and decision gates.

## The engagement
Fixed 30-day timeline: Intake & Diagnostic (days 1–3), Readiness Assessment (days 4–10), Strategy & Framework Build (days 11–21), Blueprint & Board Narrative (days 22–30).

## Pricing (fixed-fee, 50% deposit to begin)
Two entry points, both on the same 30-day timeline. Tier is set by urgency and the executive's exposure, not by company revenue or headcount.

- Standard — starting at $15,000 flat, scoping to $25,000 — 30 days. For executives without an immediate board deadline who want to get ahead of the AI conversation before it becomes urgent.
- Board-Ready / Accelerated — starting at $35,000 flat, scoping to $60,000 — 30 days. For executives with a specific board date or investor update on the calendar where AI strategy will be scrutinized. Priced against the executive's exposure and credibility risk. A $500M manufacturing company with a calm board and a $50M IT services firm with a nervous one may land in opposite tiers from what their size would suggest.

Optional add-on: full-day executive alignment offsite, 6 hours, starting at $6,000, virtual or in-person. Custom scopes available for multi-executive engagements, portfolio companies, and multi-entity organizations.

## Who it is for
Accountable leaders: CEO/President, Board Members, COO, CFO/Strategy Lead. This is working advisory, not executive education.

This is not restricted to software-company executives. SaaS, tech-enabled services, manufacturing, IT services, and any organization selling to other businesses are in scope. A COO at a manufacturing firm or an IT services CEO facing board questions about AI adoption is squarely in scope, and arguably a stronger fit than a tech company that already has in-house AI fluency.

Qualifying check — all three should be true:

1. You have a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or comparable).
2. Your team sells through outbound or inbound email and phone conversations.
3. You have a defined sales process, even an informal one.
